text: Having read your illuminating academic papers on artificial intelligence and cognitive linguistics with great admiration, I am writing to consult you regarding your graduate research projects and prospective student requirements.
As a fourth-year undergraduate student planning to apply for your research team, I would be exceedingly grateful if you could spare a few minutes to clarify three specific concerns.
In the first place, could you please provide some guidance on the primary academic prerequisites your laboratory prioritizes?
In the second place, I wonder whether students from interdisciplinary backgrounds are encouraged to participate in your ongoing grants.
Lastly, what foundational literature would you recommend reading before the upcoming interview?
Thank you very much for your precious guidance.
I look forward to your valuable insights.
